scenarios.name: BehavioralDeliveryModesAndDuplicateAnnotations
scenarios.expected_behavior: Two positive annotations for one delivered action plus one positive annotation without a delivery count sent/followed 2/2 in moment mode, 1/2 in action mode; empty IDs and unsupported adherence are excluded.

scenarios.name: DeliveredRowsOwnAgentAndTimeAttribution
scenarios.expected_behavior: A recipient action and detector annotation yield recipient sent=1/followed=0 in action mode; annotation-only detector group is absent.

scenarios.name: SourcesDevelopmentUsersAndPolicyGates
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only source0 and optional bot7, policy-source1, non-dev, nonempty-agent supported actions count; checklist21 without adherence does not enter the nonbehavior branch.

scenarios.name: MomentAndEventEligibilityGuards
scenarios.expected_behavior: With profile bot inclusion, sources0/8/7 survive all three tables; dev users, empty agents, source9 and policy-source2 do not. Sent=3, followed=6 in both action modes.

scenarios.name: KnowledgeFollowsAreDistinctActionsIncludingMissingID
scenarios.expected_behavior: Actions1/6/13/14 contribute sent=4; event9 counts distinct action IDs, including empty and unlinked IDs, so repeated event IDs across one action count once and followed=3.

scenarios.name: MixedBranchesRetainMaximumDenominators
scenarios.expected_behavior: Behavioral population2 conversations/2 agents and nonbehavioral3 conversations/1 agent produce sent=3, conversations=3, users=2, followed=2; a conversation_d row without hints contributes nothing.

scenarios.name: SameConversationCountsForEachAgent
scenarios.expected_behavior: One conversation with two agent-specific actions produces two groups and response conversation total2.

scenarios.name: UserFilterInlineAndExternalForBothDeliveryModes
scenarios.expected_behavior: Selected user survives both inline and external filters in both action modes, across all three tables. Sent=1/followed=2; excluded user is absent.

scenarios.name: ConversationStartBoundsAndTimezoneBuckets
scenarios.expected_behavior: Conversation start uses an inclusive start and exclusive end, independent of create time. Honolulu splits three included actions into Dec31 10UTC count1 and Jan1 10UTC count2.

scenarios.name: NoFrequencyKeepsTotalsAndRemovesBuckets
scenarios.expected_behavior: No frequency with agent grouping preserves all totals/rates and returns no HintStats buckets.

scenarios.name: BehaviorGroupingAndFilterUseMomentRows
scenarios.expected_behavior: Behavior grouping/filter returns the moment-owned behavior in default mode; action mode returns empty because actions lack behavior and their parser condition is false.

scenarios.name: PolicyGroupingRetainsSourceColumnMapping
scenarios.expected_behavior: Policy filter/grouping resolves policy_id on actions and action_policy_id on conversation events to the same response policy; sent=1/followed=1.

scenarios.name: HintTypeBranches
scenarios.expected_behavior: Regular, behavior, checklist, KB and GW filters each return sent1 in both modes. Regular followed0; the others followed1.

scenarios.name: MetadataIncludesUseLatestUpdateAndExcludesMissing
scenarios.expected_behavior: Latest MV update-time value selects one conversation while an older matching value and missing metadata do not count, in both action modes.

scenarios.name: MetadataExclusionAndCombinedFilters
scenarios.expected_behavior: join_use_nulls=false yields empty for exclusion-only and combined filters. join_use_nulls=true yields two conversations for exclusion-only and one for include+exclude.

scenarios.name: EmptyProfile
scenarios.expected_behavior: An empty isolated profile returns the empty full response.

scenarios.name: ConsolidatedFullRPCMatrix
scenarios.expected_behavior: 32 full RPC scenarios cover both hint delivery modes, all/selected/group-resolved users with exact dependency requests and enriched names, duration boundaries, policy filtering/display, behavior filter, groups/agent/policy combinations, bot selection, metadata include/exclude, daily time bounds and Sunday/Monday Honolulu weekly buckets. Three request validation cases assert error and nil response.

extraction.boundary: Four unaggregated source row relations with original FROM/JOIN/WHERE predicates, metadata CTEs and table-specific arguments. query("", nil) selects explicit canonical raw columns and includes its metadata CTE/arguments; explicit projections let the existing aggregate reuse the same row selections.
extraction.why: A future usage consumer can retain conversation/agent/action grain without copying the statistics aggregate or accepting its MAX denominator. Legacy query renders the original SQL shape.
invariants: No source-row DISTINCT or GROUP BY in raw mode
Raw output fields explicitly alias canonical names after metadata joins
Original enum/source/user/adherence/time/metadata guards and delivered GLOBAL IN preserved
Argument order metadata then behavioral sent, nonbehavioral sent, behavioral followed, knowledge followed
Filtered external user table remains attached by the existing reader
Metadata aliases and latest-update semantics unchanged

extraction.boundary: RPC-specific distinct counts, grouping aliases, UNION ALL, MAX denominators, sent-anchored LEFT JOIN, followed SUM, conversion and postprocessing stay in the RPC implementation.
extraction.why: Extraction shares row selection while keeping established response semantics and SQL snapshots.

preserved_issues.title: Mixed sent populations use MAX
preserved_issues.trigger: Behavioral and nonbehavioral hints occupy different conversations/users
preserved_issues.observed: Sent/conversation/user denominators are independent branch MAX values, not summed or union-distinct populations.
preserved_issues.scope: Observed real baseline and refactor; preserved, not corrected.

preserved_issues.title: Moment-based sent and followed can lack delivered actions
preserved_issues.trigger: Positive adherence annotation references a nonexistent action
preserved_issues.observed: Default sent includes it; both followed paths count it. Action mode excludes it only from sent.
preserved_issues.scope: Observed real baseline and refactor; no qualifying-use redefinition.

preserved_issues.title: Knowledge follows accept empty and unlinked action IDs
preserved_issues.observed: COUNT DISTINCT includes the empty string and IDs with no matching sent action.

preserved_issues.title: Metadata exclusion depends on nullable joins
preserved_issues.trigger: Exclusion LEFT JOIN uses IS NULL under join_use_nulls=false
preserved_issues.observed: Unmatched IDs are empty strings; both exclusion-only and combined filters return empty. Nullable joins yield intended filtered cohorts.
preserved_issues.scope: Observed with explicit settings0/1 on local CH23.8.16; production connection settings were not inspected.

preserved_issues.title: Action mode loses behavior-filtered populations
preserved_issues.trigger: Behavior filter supplied with action-based sent calculation
preserved_issues.observed: Action table has no behavior column, so the existing false filter removes sent groups.

preserved_issues.title: Agent attribution can separate sent from followed
preserved_issues.trigger: Delivered action agent differs from the adherence annotation agent
preserved_issues.observed: Action-mode recipient group has sent1/followed0; detector-only followed group is dropped by the sent-anchored LEFT JOIN.

preserved_issues.title: Conversation totals retain grouping multiplicity
preserved_issues.trigger: One conversation has actions attributed to two agents
preserved_issues.observed: Each agent group counts the conversation once and the response sums to2.

preserved_issues.title: Group/policy no-frequency per-user averages remain zero
preserved_issues.trigger: Group by GROUP and POLICY with frequency unspecified
preserved_issues.observed: Group-level per-user averages remain zero because grouped conversion derives its denominator from time buckets, which no-frequency reads omit. Top-level rates retain the original values. Both delivery modes are characterized by full-RPC assertions.
preserved_issues.scope: Observed on original and extracted production; preserved, not corrected.

risks: Real-reader characterization and supplemental raw relation execution were observed locally on fresh CH23.8.16; no production deployment/configuration inspection or performance measurement.
Reusable rows preserve legacy offered/sent/followed populations; future AssistanceUsage must explicitly implement its approved qualification rules instead of treating every row as qualifying use.
New raw API is covered by a retained supplemental verifier artifact, not a committed test against unavailable pre-extraction symbols.
Final verification executes the consolidated Go suite against real local ClickHouse; Bazel BUILD is generated but this agent did not execute the Bazel target.

supplemental_evidence.observed: All4 relations executed with explicit raw projections, external users, both delivery modes and metadata include/exclude on/off. Raw behavioral annotations stay3 when two share an action; delivered raw sent=1; raw nonbehavioral=1; raw followed annotations=3; raw knowledge events=2. Explicit output aliases fixed a new raw-only missing-column error exposed by the first smoke run.

development_notes: Initial fixture run corrected an invalid behavior resource name and documented actual nonnullable exclusion output while production remained original.
Initial development run later hit clickhouse-client exit137 while bootstrapping a late profile. Full baseline retry passed; no global Docker/credential configuration changed.
Before committing both stages Gazelle wrapper ran with --support base_test.go to generate source/test BUILD targets and dependencies.

Consolidated into the existing Hints suite using the #34001 pattern. Tests-only production is unchanged; all 16 frozen reader-test method bodies are retained. The refactor was restacked and both production Go files match the prior validated extraction byte for byte.
credentials: No AWS, Okta, Azure or SSH credentials were read, selected or used. Only local Git operations; no pushes, PRs or external messages.
self_review: Root directly reviewed final helper/RPC diff and found no semantic blocker; original predicate argument order, metadata sharing, gates, projections, grouping and MAX semantics were retained. Canonical raw aliases were reviewed.

independent_review.verdict: No demonstrated semantic blocker. Metadata predicate args shared once; relation predicates and aggregate projections/MAX retained. Raw projection canonical aliases verified independently.

old_mocked_case_mapping.evidence: Duplicate annotation IDs referencing the same action cannot inflate real distinct-action follows in either delivery mode.
